svg.text: Applied after the heat had hit, the protectant left plants worse than no treatment
Soil Arabidopsis, ACC deaminase at three timings, 37 °C for five days — repeated twice
BOTH TRIALS, BESIDE THE UNSTRESSED CONTROL
Post-treatment came in below the heat-stressed control on fresh weight in both trials — 0.103 g and 0.052 g — and bolted the most.
Pre-treatment held the most chlorophyll of the three timings, both times. This is the argument for forecasting the stress, written by our own failure.
One pot per condition, so each bar is a single measurement. This is a direction, not a dose.
Never call an agar or soil bar “statistically significant” — the replicates are technical, not biological.
